svg.title: Vertical schematic of GitHub’s 17 August capacity failure: a sidecar at its concurrency limit, four HAProxy nodes with all four flow tables full, and a Copilot Token Service retry loop behind a degraded auth gateway
svg.desc: Top, a sidecar with its concurrency gauge at 100 percent and no scale-up. Middle, four HAProxy nodes with every flow table full. Bottom, Copilot Token Service traffic rising from 7 to 9 thousand requests per second to 70 to 100 thousand through a retry loop, reached through a degraded authentication gateway. A footer strip gives 13:28 to 21:15 UTC, 7 hours 47 minutes.
